value.rationale: The theorem gives all eigenvalues, including multiplicities, and sharp rank/nullity for every natural Cartesian path–clique strip. It singles out a non-obvious arithmetic energy resonance precisely at width two and path length 2 modulo 3, proving a rank revival that neither asymptotic uniformity nor the base-path spectrum predicts. These are natural structural quantum transport invariants on ladder and clique-strip graph families; the result does not rely on an arbitrary finite slice.
